actionTaken.mechanism: A new test (ActivationSafetyGateTests.cs) asserts, as an explicit, permanently-visible regression guard: (a) TEN_K__4D__INTERMEDIATE v10's domain-blocker closure is empty (0 decisions) AND (b) activation-readiness-risks.json currently contains at least one OPEN risk AND (c) no source file under src/ references activation-readiness-risks.json or the specific TD IDs in executable (non-comment/non-string-literal-only) form.
